result:
Every file that names `LimitCheck` in code, based on a search of all `.ts`/`.tsx` sources outside `node_modules`:

- `src/types/billing.ts` defines the interface. It also names it again at line 70, in `checks: readonly LimitCheck[]`.
- `src/server/services/billing-service.ts` imports it, and `checkLimit` returns `Promise<LimitCheck>`.
- `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/members/page.tsx` imports it and uses `seats satisfies LimitCheck`.
- `src/components/domain/member/invite-member-form.tsx` has the prop `seatCheck: LimitCheck`.
- `src/components/domain/billing/usage-meter.tsx` uses it in the props type and in the parameters of `usageRatio` and `usageTone`.
- `src/components/domain/billing/seat-limit-banner.tsx` has the prop `check: LimitCheck`.
- `src/hooks/org-context.tsx` has `limitChecks: readonly LimitCheck[]`.
- `src/hooks/use-plan-limits.ts` has `checks: readonly LimitCheck[]`.
- `tests/helpers/factories.ts` defines `makeLimitCheck(overrides: Partial<LimitCheck>): LimitCheck`. This factory is the place to add a default for the new required field.
- `tests/components/activity-grouping.test.ts` imports it, and its `check()` helper returns `LimitCheck`.

I left out three kinds of files:
- **`tests/components/usage-meter.test.tsx`** only calls `makeLimitCheck()` and never names the type.
- **`src/server/services/usage-service.ts`** mentions it only in a comment.
- **`scripts/build-manifest.ts` and `scripts/manifest-parts/*`** mention it only inside documentation strings.

ANSWER: src/types/billing.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/members/page.tsx, src/components/domain/member/invite-member-form.tsx, src/components/domain/billing/usage-meter.tsx, src/components/domain/billing/seat-limit-banner.tsx, src/hooks/org-context.tsx, src/hooks/use-plan-limits.ts, tests/helpers/factories.ts, tests/components/activity-grouping.test.ts
